fightSong.title: Talk It Out
fightSong.lyrics: We will talk and talk and talk all night / Filibuster till the morning light / No vote, no end, we stand our ground / DC football, hear the sound!

stadium.name: The Rotunda
stadium.tradition: The Filibuster — a local politician reads the playbook out loud pre-game until booed off. Record: 47 minutes.

fanCulture.description: They argue about play calls like policy. After bad calls they chant 'POINT OF ORDER!' Very bureaucratic, very passionate.
fanCulture.tailgate: On the National Mall with permits filed in triplicate.

rivalries.name: The Liberty Bowl
rivalries.narrative: They ring bells, we talk. A lot.

cityFlavor: Politics, monuments, and football. We argue for a living.
